detail.longDescription:
Hey folks, does anyone have a recommendation for a native (as in, the data actually lives locally) todo app?

I'm looking for a Linear replacement that I can just put the storage of it somewhere on disk. I use it mainly to manage the backlogs of my apps - I like Projects with issues and a bit of tagging so I can keep track of what was released when.

Target OS: macOS is a must have, Debian or Fedora packages are nice to have.

PS: You can boost for reach ❤️

#IndieDev #Productivity
